entries.03820015beec9cac: This business manufactures and sells automotive wire harnesses (bundles of wiring that carry electricity and signals within automobiles) and electrical components. entries.0afd080347640009: In its 2028 Medium-Term Management Plan, announced in May 2026, the company positions fiscal 2026 as the start of its “Fourth Founding.” Shifting from “defensive selection and concentration” to “offensive selection and concentration,” it will focus on three areas: “Information Infrastructure,” “Information Storage” and “Information Terminals.” It plans to allocate management resources with priority to “Information Infrastructure” and “Information Storage,” where demand from data centers is expected to expand. The company states that in March 2026 it decided to expand optical fiber cable production capacity to up to three times the current level. The company states that from fiscal 2026 the Electronics and Automotive Business Divisions will be integrated and operated as the Electronics and Electrical Components Business Division. It also states that it is pursuing initiatives in fusion energy, drawing on its technological capabilities.
